name: page_clean
title: A clean page: the chart asked for lands on the module's own page, drawn with the kit, and Alpha's look says clean

steps.say: track what I eat: a food log with the date, the item, calories and protein in grams
steps.reply:
I made a food log with four fields: date, item, calories (kcal) and protein (g). It's empty so far. I also set it to open as a chart of calories per day.

Tell me what you eat, for example "had two eggs and toast for breakfast". I'll add a row dated today. If you don't give calories or protein, I'll estimate them and mark them as estimates.
steps.routed_by: judge: A food log that keeps tracking what the user eats is a standing table kept current over time, which takes more than one turn and no open item covers it.

steps.say: log these for the last week: Mon 12 Oct oats 350 kcal 12 g protein, chicken salad 520 kcal 42 g; Tue 13 Oct eggs 300 kcal 20 g, pasta 700 kcal 25 g; Wed 14 Oct yoghurt 200 kcal 15 g, steak 650 kcal 55 g; Thu 15 Oct toast 280 kcal 8 g, curry 800 kcal 30 g; Fri 16 Oct smoothie 320 kcal 18 g, pizza 900 kcal 35 g; Sat 17 Oct pancakes 450 kcal 10 g, salmon 600 kcal 45 g; Sun 18 Oct granola 400 kcal 12 g, soup 350 kcal 14 g
steps.reply:
I logged all 14 items for 12–18 October, with the calories and protein you gave me. Here are the daily totals:

| Day | kcal | Protein |
|---|---|---|
| Mon 12 | 870 | 54 g |
| Tue 13 | 1,000 | 45 g |
| Wed 14 | 850 | 70 g |
| Thu 15 | 1,080 | 38 g |
| Fri 16 | 1,220 | 53 g |
| Sat 17 | 1,050 | 55 g |
| Sun 18 | 750 | 26 g |

The week averages about 1,000 kcal and 49 g of protein a day. Today's total is only the two items you've told me about so far.
steps.routed: Track what I eat: a food log with the date, the item,…
steps.routed_by: judge: The sentence logs food entries into the food_log table, which is the subject of the in-focus Track what I eat item, so it continues that item rather than standing alone.

steps.say: add a line chart of my daily calories and protein to the summary page, one line each
steps.reply:
The summary page of your food log now has a line chart of daily calories and protein, one line each, for 12–18 October. Alpha's check of the page came back clean.

- **Calories:** the line uses the left axis, in kcal.
- **Protein:** the line uses the right axis, in g. It has its own scale because the numbers are much smaller.
- **New days:** the daily totals come straight from your food log, so each new day you log extends both lines.
steps.routed: Track what I eat: a food log with the date, the item,…
steps.routed_by: judge: The request adds a chart of calories and protein, the daily totals that the food log item produced, to a summary page, so it changes what that item made.
